title: Opaque credit reservoir and deterministic replay for regional limiter outages
creator: Anika Rao
description: Introduce an "opaque credit reservoir" data plane and a deterministic replay protocol to preserve tenant fairness and SLOs during limiter process crashes, regional outages, and controller split-brain. The reservoir provides soft credits (not authoritative quota) that local proxies can consume during transient control-plane loss, and a deterministic rehydration step replays committed consumption with sequence checksums to avoid double-spend or unfair replenishment.
acceptance_criteria: Local proxy can consume from opaque reservoir for at least 10s under control-plane loss while keeping per-tenant 95th latency SLO degradation < 10%
Deterministic replay avoids >0.1% double-counted tokens across a 1M-request chaos run
Eviction policy respects tenant weight and does not starve P0 customers during sustained bursts
End-to-end instrumentation surfaces reservoir size, replay gap, and reconciliation latency in Console dashboards
design_decisions: Use monotonic per-tenant sequence numbers with per-region checkpoints rather than global consensus to limit coordination latency
Reservoir entries are opaque blobs with (tenant_id, seq_start, seq_end, checksum, consumed) to allow efficient copy/merge on rejoin
Favor eventual consistency with safety checks (replay checksum mismatch triggers conservative roll-forward) over synchronous locking to preserve latency SLOs
Eviction will be 'segmented leaky buckets' with priority holdback: each tenant has segmented windows for burst vs steady-state credits
We will not use disk-backed durable mirroring in the initial rollout to avoid IO tail latencies; rehydration uses compact commit logs kept for 5 minutes
tradeoffs_and_risks: Pro: preserves low-latency serving during short controller outages; Con: some risk of over-allocation if rehydration fails and conservative fallbacks reduce throughput
Memory overhead on proxies increases (~50-100KB per hot-tenant); mitigated by LRU eviction and tombstone compression
Complexity of deterministic replay could create rare reconciliation bugs — plan includes heavy chaos testing and staged rollouts
Fairness vs availability: in extreme sustained outages we may enforce strict weighted eviction which will reduce throughput for lower-tier tenants
implementation_notes: API between proxy and controller: ReserveCredits(tenant, tokens) -> opaque_reservoir_ref or error
Reservoir GC: tombstones retained 5m; full tombstone sweep run by controller every 1h
Checksum algorithm: XXH3_64 with salt per-deployment to detect missing replay segments
Fallback path: if replay checksum mismatch, controller issues conservative debit equal to min(local_consumed, controller_account) and flags tenant for manual review
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (dev): unit tests + local integration + simulation harness (target complete by 2026-01-20)
Stage 1 (canary): 5% traffic in us-west-2 with synthetic burst tests and chaos experiment (2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-07)
Stage 2: 25% traffic across two regions (us-west-2, eu-central-1) with telemetry thresholds gating progression
Stage 3: gradual ramp to 100% with runtime-1.22 release after 2 full weeks of stable metrics
Rollback: automatic rollback if double-count rate > 0.5% or 95th latency increases > 15% for 30m
test_plan: Unit tests for reservoir encode/decode, checksum verification
Simulation harness: 1M-request chaotic limiter crash, verify no tenant starvation and double-count rate <= 0.1%
Chaos Monkey tests: kill controller leader, induce delayed rejoin, ensure deterministic replay converges
Integration test: deploy on staging with traffic shaping to validate eviction policy under sustained high load
Performance test: memory and CPU overhead profiling for proxies with 10k concurrent tenants
telemetry_requirements: Console metrics: reservoir_per_tenant_bytes, reservoir_consumed_tokens, replay_gap_ms, replay_failures_count
Alerting: replay_failures_count > 5 in 5m -> Pager; reservoir_consumed_tokens rate spike -> Ops notification
Tracing: attach reservoir_ref to request trace for postmortem and per-token attribution
SLO dashboards: per-region 95th/99th latency with an annotation layer showing canary rollout windows
